tasks.label: backend: run (H2, no MySQL)
tasks.detail: Runs the Spring Boot API on http://localhost:8090 using an in-memory H2 database. No MySQL credentials required.

tasks.label: backend: run (MySQL)
tasks.detail: Runs the Spring Boot API on http://localhost:8090 against MySQL. Set DB_URL, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD and JWT_SECRET in your environment first.

tasks.label: frontend: dev
tasks.detail: Runs the Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173 and proxies /api to the backend on port 8090.
